confluences: Confluence 1: ICT/SMC, FVG, and Trend Indicators. Confluence 2: MSNR, Quarter Theory, and Volatility Indicators. The high volatility (M15 ATR of 321.97) suggests that any corrective pullback will be rapid and sharp, leading to a swift wick-rejection at the defensive staff zone (78110.00 - 78250.00) before expanding upwards.

Confluence 3: BOS, Supply/Demand, and Volume Indicators. A Fibonacci retracement drawn from the swing low of 77746.60 to the swing high of 78695.40 places the golden 0.5 (78221.00) and 0.618 (78109.00) levels directly inside our defensive staff zone. Confluence 5: CRT (Candle Range Theory), Chart Patterns, and Volatility (Bollinger Bands). Under Candle Range Theory, the accumulation phase below 78000 has transitioned into a violent expansion phase. This breakout forms a classic W-pattern (double bottom) on the H1 timeframe. Bollinger Bands are expanding rapidly due to high volatility, indicating that the lower band will act as dynamic support near the 78070.00 invalidation level, protecting our tight stop loss.
